description: Land Acquisition - Kiriporuwa, Bulathkohupitiya D/S Division, Kegalle District
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire specific allotments of land (Kiriporuwa Part II) for resettlement of displaced persons by landslides. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, including descriptions of the land parcels to be acquired, claimant information, and compensation claim procedures. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition and property matters.
